data.name: Faheemat
data.gender_notes: Faheemat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who is free from sin
data.long_meaning: A person who is absolved from all sins and imperfections, derived from the Arabic root fa-ha-ma which means to be free from. The name Faheemat carries the meaning “One who is free from sin” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faheemat usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is free from sin and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the verse 'And We have sent you not, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy for the peoples.' (Quran 21:107)
data.etymology: Faheemat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is free from sin.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faheemat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
